_doc: Dishes this estate has already ruled on. Read by sourcers BEFORE fetching and by adjudicators as prior art. Written by the DECIDER only - it is already the single writer of selection state. Advisory: a sourcer may return a previously-rejected dish with a stated reason.
_key: protein|method|sauce-family - identity, not slug, because slugs vary by publisher and the same dinner recurs under many names.

dishes.name: Bacon Cheeseburger Egg Casserole
dishes.reason: Same cheeseburger-beef dinner as accepted keto-cheeseburger-skillet; egg-custard bake vs skillet is a format re-plating, not a new dish. Second American low-carb cheeseburger beef entry in one run; catalog already American-heavy.

dishes.name: Beef Cauliflower Taco Skillet
dishes.reason: Near-dupe of catalog loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls: shares protein (ground beef), Tex-Mex taco flavor family, and skillet method; cauliflower-rice swap is the only structural change. Catalog Tex-Mex beef lane is already dense (loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls, tex-mex-beef-rice-skillet-bowls, beef-enchilada-skillet-bowls) so it deepens not widens; plus 34g carbs sits ~1g under the ceiling and a label-accurate recompute (15oz black beans) risks breaching 35g. Cut - run does not need padding.

dishes.name: Beef Egg Roll In A Bowl
dishes.reason: Third protein-swap of an existing catalog dish: pork-egg-roll-in-a-bowl and turkey-egg-roll-in-a-bowl-over-rice both live. Same identity (ground meat + cabbage + soy/hoisin/sesame/ginger stir-fry); beef adds no new dinner.

dishes.name: Broccoli Smoked Sausage Cheddar Bake
dishes.reason: Dupe of accepted baked-cauliflower-mac-smoked-sausage: same smoked-sausage + cruciferous-floret + cheddar/cream low-carb oven bake (floret swap only). Also collides with accepted sheet-pan-smoked-sausage-broccoli-cheddar and keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole.

dishes.name: Broccoli Smoked Sausage Cream Cheese Bake
dishes.reason: Pool twin of kept sheet-pan-smoked-sausage-broccoli-cheddar (same protein+broccoli+cheddar, method differs) AND cross-protein twin of accepted keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole (same rice-free creamy broccoli-cheddar oven bake); weaker at 20g protein. Ship only the dry sheet-pan.

dishes.name: Buffalo Chicken Cauliflower Casserole

dishes.name: Burmese Chicken Dal Curry

dishes.name: Cheese Smothered Pork Chops

Generic American, widens nothing; keep the stronger wine plate, not two smothered pork chops.

Keto binder swap + dropping the starchy side does not change the entree. Borderline low-carb-variant angle noted for audit; run has turkey coverage, not promoting.

dishes.name: Low Carb Cheesy Beef Broccoli Skillet
dishes.reason: Cross-lane same-dinner twin of accepted keto-turkey-broccoli-cheddar-casserole (ground protein + broccoli + cheddar cream sauce, no starch); beef lane already runaway

dishes.name: Low Carb Chicken Bacon Broccoli Cauliflower Bake
dishes.reason: CROSS-LANE dupe of chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake (accepted earlier THIS run - invisible to the adjudicator, whose accepted_slugs_checked listed only creamy-tuscan). Both are low-carb crustless CHICKEN + BACON + CAULIFLOWER + CHEDDAR oven bakes with no starch: same protein, same method, same base, same bacon+cheddar signature - four of four structural axes. Difference is only binder (egg custard vs cream/cream-cheese), added broccoli, and garlic-mustard vs ranch seasoning - a seasoning/veg nuance, not a distinct plate. The ranch bake was accepted first and its own selection note pre-flagged this exact slug as the near-duplicate to reject. Cut.

dishes.name: Low Carb Korean Beef Bulgogi
dishes.reason: Dupe of catalog beef-bulgogi-rice-bowls: same sliced-steak protein, same soy/sesame/sweet-fruit bulgogi marinade, same sear method; only the rice starch is dropped (rubric: same protein+sauce minus starch = one dish). Korean already covered by accepted slow-cooker-korean-galbi-jjim-short-ribs.

dishes.name: Low Carb Unstuffed Cabbage Beef Skillet

dishes.name: Sauerbraten German Braised Beef

Cross-lane borderline-dupe of accepted crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche: both crustless oven-baked pork + egg + cheese no-starch bakes (3-4 of 4 axes; adjudicator could not see that pork acceptance). Also pork was already tied for most-represented protein (4 of 13) with more pork candidates streaming in - not padding a second pork egg bake.

dishes.name: Sausage Spinach Crustless Quiche
dishes.reason: Pool dupe of sausage-cottage-cheese-egg-bake and cross-lane dupe of accepted crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche: crustless pork + egg + cheese no-starch bake, fat-forward 18g protein (weakest of the three). Only one crustless pork egg bake survives this run (the accepted gruyere quiche).

dishes.name: Easy Chicken Cordon Bleu

dishes.name: Sausage and Rice - One Pot!

dishes.name: Creamy Roasted Garlic Chicken

dishes.name: Rotisserie Flavoured Chicken and Potato Bake

dishes.name: Baked Honey Mustard Chicken
dishes.reason: Baked chicken breasts topped with mozzarella in a honey + grain-mustard glaze; distinct honey-mustard sauce family with no live match (existing honey chicken is hot-honey, chipotle or sesame), saturation 2, band verified 547cal/23c/62p.

dishes.name: How to Roast a Chicken
dishes.reason: Basic whole roast chicken with lemon, garlic and a bundle of fresh herbs; identical dinner identity to ina-garten-s-roast-chicken accepted earlier this same run (whole-bird herb-lemon roast), so the slot is already taken.

dishes.name: Tex Mex Baked Chicken

dishes.name: Stuffed Baked Pork Chops with Prosciutto and Mozzarella
dishes.reason: Boneless center-cut chops stuffed with prosciutto/mozzarella/spinach, baked, no starch; verified 235cal/2.5c/36p. Distinct from all live pork-chop dinners (all sauced or starched) and from the in-flight creamy-garlic-herb-wine chop — a stuffed Italian format the catalog lacks.

dishes.name: Beef and Cauliflower Taco Skillet
dishes.reason: Ground-beef Tex-Mex taco skillet with black beans and cauliflower rice; duplicates live loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls (protein + taco spice family + skillet method), cauliflower swap does not distinguish the plate. Deepens an already-dense Tex-Mex beef lane rather than widening it; consistent with prior ruling on the same dish.

dishes.name: One Skillet Oven Baked Chicken Shawarma and Rice Pilaf

dishes.name: Chicken Adobo

Catalog already holds two adobo chicken dishes (also a burrito), so this is a near-duplicate of an existing dinner rather than a distinct regional take.

dishes.name: Air Fryer Breaded Chicken Breast

dishes.name: Roast Eye of Round Beef
dishes.reason: Oven-roasted eye of round with red-wine mushroom pan gravy and vegetables; verified 486cal/10c/40p, no live dupe (catalog pot-roast bowls are braised, different plate).
